proves.claim: clause 1: a proposed sentinel watch awaiting the person appears in the view's needs with its command, directory, schedule and exact digest.

view.io-needs.sentinel-drafts-listed.why: A watch the person cannot see cannot be approved, and the 0.9.4 item screen controls were lost with no test naming them.

proves.claim: clause 2: approving a sentinel draft from the view records the same person decision pullboard sentinel approve records, and refuses a stale digest.

view.io-needs.sentinel-approve-records-c.why: A view approval that recorded something other than the CLI's decision would run a command the person did not approve.

proves.claim: clause 2: declining a sentinel draft from the view needs a reason and records the decline the CLI records.

view.io-needs.sentinel-decline-records-r.why: A decline with no reason, or a different record, would leave the proposer no word on why the watch was refused.
